messages:
Sam (Design): Quick thread: proposing an 'axis summarization' mode for cramped dashboard cards. Idea: keep the visual scale stable by annotating extreme values with a compact badge instead of auto-rescaling. Low friction, mobile-friendly. Thoughts?

Ivy (PM): Love the stability goal. Main concern: SREs might miss critical spikes if they're summarized. How do we present enough context? :thinking_face:

Noah (Viz): Don't hide data. Proposal: render raw line faint + smoothed overlay; detect outliers via robust z-score (z = (v-median)/MAD) and flag points where |z|>4. Show a badge "+n spikes" that expands to a small accessible list with timestamps and percentage delta. If outliers are consecutive (>=3) treat as a trend and show full scale.

Jo (Frontend): Implementation note: chart.mode = 'summarized'|'full'. In summarized: show 2 ticks, move unit to panel header, badges in top-right. Prototype will use Canvas for lines + DOM badges for interaction. Pseudo:
```
const isOutlier = (v, median, mad) => Math.abs((v-median)/mad) > 4;
if (isOutlier(v)) recordSpike(t,v);
else feedSmoother(v);
```
Will ship a prototype branch.

Kim (A11y): Accessibility: label the expand control "Show detailed axis". Keyboard should open a table with (time,value,delta). Screen reader should announce "2 spikes summarized between 14:00 and 14:05" when collapsed. Badge color must meet contrast and not be the only cue.

Sam (Design): Visual notes: small 9px pill badge, chevron, and on hover a micro-tooltip "Spike at 14:02: +220% vs median". Use dotted smoothed overlay and solid raw behind. For dark/light themes use stroke variants.

Ivy (PM): Rollout: feature-flag chart.axis_summarization, pilot on mobile-heavy beta orgs. Track expansion rate and time-to-expand.

ci-bot: Branch "axis-summarization-proto" created, CI queued.

Jo (Frontend): I'll push a minimal demo soon. Noah will drop test CSVs (clean, noisy, spike-heavy). Reconvene in 72h. :rocket:
